title: auto-build-loop automation.json (schema_version 2)
description: Contract for specs/<feature>/automation.json consumed by scripts/auto-build-loop.sh. schema_version 1 documents (without the unattended block) remain valid and resolve to pre-#190 behavior. Enforced by scripts/validate-automation-config.sh (jq-based, so hosts need no JSON-Schema tooling); this file is the authoritative contract the script mirrors. Increment A of #190: the three unattended.on_* keys accept ONLY "terminate" — recovery values (adjudicate, swap_builder) do not exist until increment D and must be unrequestable; on_origin_gate is terminate-only in ALL increments (an agent re-checking alignment against a spec it may have misread is circular).

estimate_usd_per_invocation.description: Conservative worst-case debit for an invocation whose real cost is unmeasurable. Debits the SAME caps.cost_usd (no separate allowance); flagged estimated:true in the ledger.

caps.description: Under profile: unattended, both caps MUST be explicit — no silent defaults (#190 §2: the published cost anchors run 5-8x the old default).
